content:
incident-bot: PAGER: traffic anomaly detected in eu-west. Economy tier requests 5xx rate jumped to 12% (baseline 0.4%) starting ~2895554200. Auto-escalation to on-call.
alice_oncall: On it — pulling dashboards. Can someone paste the current policy weights for eu-west?
ben_ops: grabbing routing weights now, looks like economy lane weight was 0.35 -> 0.6 for a canary earlier today.
chiara_sre: Confirmed spike correlated with a batch of heavy embeddings from partner X hitting economy. KV cache hit went from 78% -> 21%.
dino_infra: Query run: 
```
SELECT tier, count(*), avg(latency_ms), error_rate FROM requests WHERE region='eu-west' AND ts > 2895553600 GROUP BY tier;
```
results: economy 42k reqs avg 210ms err 12% ; standard 11k reqs avg 95ms err 0.6%
alice_oncall: Impact: customer-facing degraded in eu-west for economy tier. Recommend immediate mitigation: 1) throttle economy by 50% (rate limit), 2) pin routing to standard for new sessions, 3) inform support. Who can apply rate cap now?
ben_ops: Applying ratecap on policy id policy-eu-003. Will set economy:max_rps_per_customer=0.5x and reduce global weight to 0.2. Pushing change.
ops-bot: policy-update job started: policy-eu-003 patch {"economy_weight":0.2,"throttle_ratio":0.5} (job id job-8923)
ben_ops: job-8923 succeeded. New weight in control plane: economy=0.2, standard=0.7, priority=0.1
chiara_sre: Launching emergency reroute for new sessions in eu-west: setting smart-route rule to prefer standard and priority for region eu-west. Command:
```
redwoodctl routing update --region eu-west --rule "prefer:standard,priority" --scope sessions
```
ops-bot: routing-change accepted (change id ch-5592). CDN and edge should pick up within ~30s.
alice_oncall: Also enabling quota isolation for partner X to limit burst: calling quota API.
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/quotas -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"customer":"partner-x","max_rps":20}'
```
ops-bot: quota update queued -> quota-id q-775
dino_infra: Observability: open probes show tail latency and error rate falling in last 2m. Economy errors from 12% -> 6% after route change.
evan_pm: Heads-up to support: please send canned note to impacted customers in eu-west about degraded performance and that we're mitigating; include ETA 30m.
alice_oncall: Sending status update in #support right now. Monitoring for 15m, if errors <1% we can revert throttles slowly. Leaving note in incident channel for postmortem.
chiara_sre: Adding short-term circuit rule to drop any requests hitting model-a-quantized when seq_len>1024 in economy (they were causing OOMs). Patch applied.
ben_ops: Confirmed no further escalations from partner X. Logs show 30% fewer concurrent KV misses.
alice_oncall: Great work. Marking this as mitigated for paging. Creating follow-up ticket for root cause (mis-tagged canary traffic) and model-specific guardrails. :pray:
incident-bot: Incident update logged: incident-2895554321 created, severity=3, mitigated_by=alice_oncall, mitigation_actions=[throttle,economy_weight_reduction,routing_reroute,quota_isolation,model_seq_guardrails]
